chunks: 33. My father (RA) narrated, saying: 'Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Kufi narrated from his father al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn 'Abd Allah al-Kufi, from his grandfather 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Isma'il ibn Muslim, that he asked Al-Sadiq (AS):
about the prayer behind one who denies the decree of Allah, the Mighty and High. He (AS) said: 'Then he should repeat all the prayers he has prayed behind him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on prayer behind an Imam who denies divine decree?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (AS) ruled that prayers behind an Imam who denies divine decree (al-Qadar) are invalid and must be repeated, emphasizing that theological correctness regarding God's attributes is a prerequisite for the validity of congregational prayer. This ruling underscores the Shia principle that the Imam's adherence to core tenets of faith, such as Qadar, directly impacts the spiritual efficacy of the worship performed in his presence.
